March 8, 2018 - By Ruchi Gupta 
Seaward Management Limited Partnership decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 2.38% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Seaward Management Limited Partnership sold 17,879 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 734,769 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $113.24M, down from 752,648 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Seaward Management Limited Partnership who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $890.03 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.22% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $175.41. About 3.60M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
First City Capital Management Inc increased its stake in General Electric Co (GE) by 19.51% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. First City Capital Management Inc bought 18,730 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.64% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 114,711 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.77M, up from 95,981 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First City Capital Management Inc who had been investing in General Electric Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $126.51B market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $14.57. About 5.79M shares traded. General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) has declined 4.46% since March 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.16% the S&P500.
